user.title: Sign in to Carrier SmartHome
user.description: Sign in using Carrier's native GraphQL API. After setup, choose cloud or local Matter control from Configure. On Home Assistant OS, use Home Assistant's built-in Matter integration to add your thermostat; Carrier discovers it automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Carrier SmartHome
reauth_confirm.description: Your Carrier session needs to be reauthenticated.

error.invalid_auth: Carrier did not accept the credentials or login method.
error.cannot_connect: The Carrier SmartHome API could not be reached or returned an unexpected response.
error.no_devices: Login succeeded, but Carrier returned no entry-level thermostats for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Carrier account is already configured.

init.title: Choose thermostat
init.description: Select the Carrier thermostat whose controls you want to configure.

transport.title: Choose how to control this thermostat
transport.description: Cloud requires no extra setup. For local Matter, Carrier automatically reuses Home Assistant's existing Matter controller; you don't need to provide an IP or node ID.

auto.title: Choose your commissioned Carrier thermostat
auto.description: Carrier detected compatible devices using Home Assistant's existing Matter controller. Pick the physical thermostat you want to link.

confirm.title: Confirm this is the same physical thermostat
confirm.description: Verify that the selected Matter thermostat belongs to the selected Carrier account device. Model identity alone cannot distinguish two identical units.

data.verified_same_device: I verified this is the same physical thermostat

matter_required.title: Set up Home Assistant Matter first
matter_required.description: No reachable, commissioned Carrier thermostat was found in Home Assistant Matter. On Home Assistant OS, add the built-in Matter integration in Settings → Devices & services, then pair/share your Carrier thermostat with the Home Assistant Companion app. On Home Assistant Container, Matter requires a separate controller service managed by your deployment. Carrier cannot safely install a Docker daemon or Matter server from HACS. Retry after pairing, or use the advanced connection option.

advanced.title: Advanced: existing Matter controller
advanced.description: For users who manage their own controller. Connect only to a Matter Server on a trusted private IP; no automatic commissioning is performed.
